newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lukoil sees 1997 sales rising to 55-60 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Lukoil sees 1997 sales rising to 55-60 trln rbls.

text.p: Russia's largest oil producer LUKoil forecasts consolidated 1997 net profit, calculated to Russian accounting standards on a cash basis, will rise to 40-4.5 trillion roubles ($692.6-$779.2 million) from 3.87 trillion roubles in 1996, spokesman Pyotr Neyev said on Wednesday.
LUKoil 1997 consolidated sales, including joint ventures, would rise to 55-60 trillion roubles from 43.99 trillion, he quoted the company's annual report as saying.
Neyev confirmed an earlier LUKoil estimate that consolidated oil output would rise two percent in 1997 from 58.5 million tonnes (1.17 million barrels per day) in 1996.
LUKoil will refine 2.5 percent more oil than last year's 19.3 million tonnes (386,000 bpd), he said.
LUKoil officials will present the figures at the holding company's annual meeting on Thursday.
